svg.title: Three ways to build on watsonx.ai
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Predict and plan: forecasting, classification and risk models, with Decision Optimization for planning and scheduling. Answer from your own documents: retrieval-augmented generation. Tune it to the task: prompt engineering, tuning and other ways to fit a model to specialized work.
